notes.content: Craft dream spaces, tackle exciting blast levels, and dive deep into your clients' stories. Every design choice tells a story - make yours unforgettable!

notes.title: Home Designer Makeover Blast is Leveling Up with Five New DLCs!
notes.content:
Ryan's Halloween Hallway
Embrace the spooky season with us! Ryan is calling on your design prowess to transform a room into a Halloween spectacle of hauntingly delightful hallways. Your creativity will weave a tapestry of eerie and enchanting decors, casting a spell on every visitor!

Unlock Even More with Power-Packed DLCs!
The excitement doesn’t stop there! Dive into four additional DLCs, each loaded with boosters, coins, and gems, propelling your design journey into new realms of stunning and spectacular spaces. Get ready for a dazzling upgrade to your path in creating unforgettable stories through design!

notes.content: Home Designer Makeover Blast is out of Early Access! Begin your design journey! Craft dream spaces, tackle exciting blast levels, and dive deep into your clients' stories. Every design choice tells a story - make yours unforgettable!

notes.title: Strongblade is coming to Steam on September 14, 2023
notes.content:
Soon you can travel through a captivating world filled with puzzles, outsmart cunning villains, befriend charming animals, and build unique camps.

Strongblade is a vibrant, match-3 puzzle adventure with an irresistible charm. As Sean the Mouse, you'll navigate through a stunning world full of puzzles and obstacles, make friends with lovable animal characters, and outsmart crafty villains.

The game features over 30 distinct mechanics and thousands of levels, each packed with thrilling power-ups and combinations. Beyond just solving puzzles, you'll be exploring new territories, setting up and decorating unique campsites, and unearthing treasure chests filled with coins, power-ups, and boosters.

The excitement doesn't stop there. Strongblade lets you compete in heart-pounding in-game events against players from all over. With each level completed, you help brave Sean on his adventurous journey.

So dive into Strongblade's colorful world today. It's not just a game; it's a thrilling adventure filled with fun, challenges, and delightful surprises around every corner.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2430830/Strongblade__Puzzle_Quest_Match_3_and_Match3_Adventure_Puzzle/

notes.title: Home Designer Blast News
notes.content:
Dear Steam Community,

We understand many of you have been eagerly anticipating the release of our game. However, we've made the tough decision to postpone the release date. Our aim is to deliver an immersive, enriching, and flawless gaming experience. To meet this commitment, we believe it's vital to take a little more time to polish and refine the game.

notes.title: Home Designer Blast: Coming to Steam on June 23, 2023
notes.content: We're excited to share that Home Designer Blast is set to make its debut on Steam this June 23, 2023. Gear up for an immersive gaming experience in the world of home design. Your ongoing support is immensely appreciated.
